# temps_team (Resource)

A team of users. Grant it a role on projects with `temps_project_access`; members are managed in the console. Deleting a team removes its project grants.

Import with the team ID.

Required API key permissions: `users:read`, `users:write`, `users:delete`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "temps_team" "platform" {
  name        = "Platform"
  slug        = "platform"
  description = "Runs the shared infrastructure"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name.
- `slug` (String) Unique identifier: lower-case letters, digits and `-`. The API cannot rename it, so changing it replaces the team.

### Optional

- `description` (String) What the team is for.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Numeric team ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import temps_team.platform 2
```
